headline: Helloween & the Guardian of the Depths - version 1.9.0
openingRemarks: The second Titan has arrived, and he's ruff around the edges...

newFeatures.title: Guardian of the Depths
newFeatures.description: This pup is the second Titan to enter the game. The Guardian of the Depths is Earth & Fire proficient, and has an 'Afterburn' ability (similar to the dragon whelp) but much more potent.

newFeatures.title: Hellhound Whisperer
newFeatures.description: Sniff out this special new title by defeating the Guardian of the Depths!

newFeatures.title: Helloween
newFeatures.description: A special event running now until Halloween. There is a 13% bonus chance to face the Guardian of the Depths in random encounters

bugFixes: Fixed a bug recently introduced where pet abilities were not being applied before battles
balanceChanges: Reduced difficulty of all foes very slightly
closingRemarks: Very excited about the progress being made on the mobile app, but I had to get this new baddy in the game!
